heritage.title: Craftsmanship
heritage.text:
Every Qashabia carries the character of traditional Algerian craftsmanship.

We pay attention to the details that make each piece special — from the texture of the wool and the stitching to the finishing touches.

At Bled Heritage, we present Qashabia Messaad with a refined approach while preserving its traditional character and distinctive details.
